scope: Append-only external metadata. Existing W8 preparation/derivation preserve the v8 pin as the draft available at their authoring time; neither file is rewritten.

draftV8.executionStateBasis: Root preexecute review reports v8 was never executed; no actual execution receipt is claimed.
draftV8.defect: v8 calls backendBinding while the on-disk binding remains PENDING, but the immutable reader requires finalized metadata before that call.

selectedV9.ordering: Root reports the previously validated order: final metadata becomes available before backendBinding validation. On validation failure, original pending binding/config raw bytes are restored and an error receipt is retained.

laterW8PublicArchive.interpretation: Archive v9 as the selected actual tool with its eventual true execution receipt; retain v8 as an unexecuted draft and this concise reference correction. Never claim v8 passed an execution.
